decks.notes: This deck revolves around aggressive playstyle using auras as the main source of power. The key strategy is to quickly and efficiently enchant your creatures with a combination of auras such as Cartouche of Solidarity, Ethereal Armor, and All That Glitters, giving them significant boosts in power and toughness. Gladecover Scout and Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice are the main creatures used in this strategy. The deck also includes protective spells like Rune of Sustenance and Kaya's Ghostform, as well as combat tricks like Audacity. The lands provide a balanced mana base to support the gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful creatures and planeswalkers. By using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, along with enchantments like Wolfwillow Haven, the deck aims to generate a lot of mana to cast high-costed creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also includes cards like Storm the Festival and Karn, the Great Creator to provide additional value and threats. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly building up a strong board presence to overwhelm opponents.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells and hand disruption while using board wipes to control the battlefield. Memory manipulation and card advantage are key components, with cards like Narset and Day's Undoing helping to filter through the deck. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and utility lands to ensure it can adapt to a variety of matchups. By carefully managing resources and knowledge of the opponent's hand, this deck aims to outsmart and outlast its opponents in a battle of wits.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously tutor for powerful creatures and enchantments to control the game. With a wide variety of threats and answers available in the main deck, paired with the consistency of the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents with a mix of disruption and strong threats. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the diverse color requirements of the deck's cards, enabling it to consistently cast its spells and maintain control of the battlefield.

This deck aims to control the game by using the Fires of Invention enchantment to cast powerful spells for free. The key concept revolves around ramping up mana quickly with cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Beanstalk Wurm, while also utilizing card draw from Keruga, the Macrosage. The deck includes a variety of powerful creatures like Cavalier of Flame and Kenrith, the Returned King to maintain board presence and close out games. With access to a diverse range of lands and spells, this deck can adapt to different situations and outpace opponents in the late game.

The key concept of this deck is to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy with a mix of aggressive creatures and discard spells. The deck focuses on removing threats with cards like Go for the Throat, Fatal Push, and Abrupt Decay, while also using hand disruption through Thoughtseize. The creatures in the deck, such as Phyrexian Obliterator, Questing Beast, and Elder Gargaroth, provide powerful threats that can close out the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred's Edict allows for additional disruption and removal options.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro - Humans deck focuses on building a strong board presence with Human creatures. The key strategy revolves around playing cheap creatures like Hopeful Initiate and Thalia's Lieutenant to quickly buff them up. Cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Reflector Mage disrupt the opponent's strategy, giving the Humans an advantage. Collected Company helps to quickly bring more creatures onto the battlefield. The deck also includes lands that support the Human tribal theme, such as Unclaimed Territory and Cavern of Souls. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive human army.

This deck is focused on quickly getting Arclight Phoenixes onto the battlefield and using cheap spells to fuel their reanimation. It utilizes cards like Izzet Charm, Chart a Course, and Sleight of Hand to find and discard the Phoenixes, while also providing additional utility. The deck also includes a few counterspells like Spikefield Hazard and Spell Pierce for interaction and protection, as well as card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise to maintain card advantage. The land base consists of various dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent mana production.

The deck focuses on aggressive strategies utilizing powerful creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes a mix of efficient removal such as Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow allows for additional pressure and resilience. The deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan, ultimately leading to victory through a combination of early aggression and strategic disruption.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. It combines the power of Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester with disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the game and maintain pressure. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Misery's Shadow provide additional threats that can quickly end the game if left unchecked. The deck also features removal spells like Fatal Push, Heartless Act, and Power Word Kill to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of aggression and disruption.

This aggro deck aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also removing threats with Fatal Push and Bonecrusher Giant. The deck utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to control the board and pressure the opponent. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides card advantage and recursion, while cards like Beseech the Mirror and Invoke Despair offer additional reach and disruption. The deck's mana base is designed to support its aggressive game plan, with a mix of lands that produce both black and red mana.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on dealing damage to the opponent through sacrificing creatures and triggering abilities like Mayhem Devil's. It also includes cards like Kroxa and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure early on. The deck features removal spells like Fatal Push and discard spells like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. With cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with sacrificing and recurring creatures while controlling the board. Castle Locthwain provides card advantage while Den of the Bugbear offers a potential threat.

This red aggro deck focuses on quickly reducing the opponent's life total through fast, efficient creatures and burn spells. It utilizes low-cost creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear, along with burn spells such as Lightning Strike and Skewer the Critics, to apply constant pressure and finish off opponents. The deck also includes card draw options like Light Up the Stage to maintain momentum. By combining aggressive creatures with direct damage spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

This aggressive Red Deck Wins archetype focuses on efficiently dealing damage to the opponent with fast, low-cost creatures like Soul-Scar Mage, Monastery Swiftspear, and Ghitu Lavarunner. The deck utilizes burn spells like Wizard's Lightning, Skewer the Critics, and Play with Fire to further pressure the opponent. Card advantage is gained through Light Up the Stage, while land cards like Ramunap Ruins and Den of the Bugbear provide additional damage. The key strategy is to maintain a steady flow of damage and quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful ETB (enter the battlefield) effects in combination with cards like Retraction Helix to generate infinite mana and win the game. By using cards like Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy and Lukka, Coppercoat Outcast to cheat creatures into play, the deck can combo off quickly and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also has access to cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Mox Amber to further enable its combo potential and ensure a quick victory. The key is to assemble the combo pieces and execute the combo efficiently to secure the win.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. It also uses Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to create a token copy of a creature. The deck includes disruption with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize, as well as removal with Fatal Push and Heartless Act. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck's strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements for casting its spells.

The deck focuses on using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. The goal is to quickly assemble a threatening board presence and overwhelm the opponent before they can effectively respond. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds another layer of consistency and power to the strategy. With a combination of removal spells, disruption, and efficient threats, this deck aims to quickly establish dominance and take control of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Reckoner Bankbuster. It also includes support cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Thoughtseize, and Fatal Push to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional benefits and utility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements efficiently. This deck aims to assemble powerful combos and overwhelming board presence to quickly outmatch the opponent.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal while generating card advantage through card draw and Teferi's abilities. The deck aims to control the board with board wipes and counterspells to outvalue opponents and eventually win the game with Shark Typhoon tokens or by ultimating Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The mana base includes lands that provide different colors of mana and utility lands to support the deck's strategy. The deck is designed to slow down the game and grind out wins through resource management and efficient removal.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal while utilizing Teferi, Hero of Dominaria's card advantage and board control. The deck aims to control the game with cards like Supreme Verdict and Shark Typhoon while also having the option to create a powerful finisher with Memory Deluge and Shark Typhoon. The deck includes lands that provide additional utility and options, such as Thespian's Stage and Lotus Field. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around outlasting opponents and taking control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with low-cost creatures and using cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to pump them up. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures and use protection spells like Brave the Elements to protect them. Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale provide additional creature options and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire offers protection for key creatures. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, aiming to win the game quickly before the opponent can establish their own board presence.
